title: Knot Detail Knit Glitter Long Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at the next wedding with this chic dress! Featuring a flattering knot detail and fitted sleeves, this knit design hugs your curves beautifully. Perfectly elegant yet comfortable, it's the ultimate choice for celebrating love in style!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Fitted sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
